parties.respondent: The State of Madhya Pradesh (Now State of Chhattisgarh)

summary: Conviction for murder under IPC s.302 r/w 149; bomb attacks leading to deaths; FIR delay of 2 hours justified due to injuries/witness trauma; alibi defense rejected; witness testimonies consistent despite kinship; multiple injuries corroborated by medical evidence; High Court affirmation of conviction upheld; no evidence of prior deliberation or prosecution embellishment.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.148, s.302 r/w 149, s.307 r/w 149
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence confirmed; High Court judgment upheld.
